rows: Strong thunderstorm winds damaged the school in Eula and several houses around the community.
Strong thunderstorm winds peeled back the roof of a carport.

A trained spotter in Cross Plains observed severe hail for about 10 minutes. The hail grew to the size of tennis balls for a time before ending. In addition to the large hail, wind gusts to 68 mph were occuring at the same time as well.
Wind gusts to 68 mph were reported along with tennis ball size hail.
Trees were blown down in Cross Plains as minor structural damage was reported.
Power poles were reported down in town.
A wind gust of 58 mph was reported.

A storm spotter reported that a roof was blown off of a motel in Cross Plains.

A storm chaser photographed this tornado. The twister broke some mesquite tree limbs.
Several storm chasers reported this as a rope tornado that lasted about 3 minutes.
A storm chaser and trained storm spotter reported this tornado briefly touched down in an open field. It broke a few mesquite tree limbs.
A storm chaser reported a large multivortex tornado near U.S. Highway 283 near the Shackelford - Callahan County line. A person who lived near the area also saw this tornado.
